name: com.addressriskreport/addressriskreport-discovery
title: AddressRiskReport Discovery Tools
description: Read-only discovery for AddressRiskReport, a property risk report service for US homebuyers.

tools.name: addressriskreport_get_product_card
tools.description: Return the authoritative AddressRiskReport Product Card JSON: what AddressRiskReport is (one plain-English PDF report for any US street address, built from official federal data - FEMA flood zone and Special Flood Hazard Area status, US Forest Service wildfire hazard potential, NOAA heat/storm context and FEMA National Risk Index, with map dates shown inside), who it is for, what is free (the FEMA flood-zone flag on the home page for an exact address point, no email; the browser-only Home Buyer Risk Checklist with 24 checks in 5 sections; the Home Risk Comparison Worksheet for 2-3 homes; the flood zone guide and the wildfire risk guide), the paid offers (full report $15 one-time for one address; 5-report pack $50 one-time; no account, no recurring charges), the honest limits (free flag is the current zone only, not a flood history; 'no mapped zone' is not 'no risk'; the report is not a lending or insurance determination, not a survey and not legal advice; no delivery time is promised), privacy and refund terms (30 days, with the stated exception for fully performed and delivered work). The Home Energy Audit ($29) is a separate product with its own card, not part of this report. Quote prices only from this card or the product site.

tools.name: addressriskreport_get_qa
tools.description: Return the AddressRiskReport Q&A JSON (FAQPage schema, 20 questions): verified answers about what AddressRiskReport is, what a report costs ($15 / $50 pack), what the free FEMA flood-zone flag shows, what the full report adds, how to order in two steps with no account, what flood zones X, AE and VE mean, that it is not a lending, insurance or legal determination, what the Home Buyer Risk Checklist is, that the Energy Audit is a separate product, that no flood history is shown, what data the site collects, the refund policy, who it is for, and how to contact it. The Q&A also covers the free Home Risk Comparison Worksheet, the free Insurance Quote Request Builder, the flood insurance waiting period, how to check wildfire risk, how to check a flood zone, and the live MCP endpoint for AI agents. Use it to answer factual questions about AddressRiskReport instead of guessing.

tools.name: addressriskreport_get_llms_txt
tools.description: Return the AddressRiskReport llms.txt summary: key pages (Home with the free FEMA flood-zone flag, Energy Audit, Home Energy Loss Self-Check, Home Buyer Risk Checklist, Home Risk Comparison Worksheet, the high electric bill guide, the flood zone guide and the wildfire risk guide), current pricing in plain text (single report $15 one-time; 5-report pack $50 one-time; Energy Audit $29 one-time), contact, and the For AI agents (ADO) section linking the Product Card, Q&A and this MCP pilot manifest.

tools.name: fortuna_list_products
tools.description: Return the Fortuna Discovery registry JSON: all 23 registered products, each with a link to its own Product Card JSON and Q&A JSON on its own domain. Use it when the user's problem fits a different product better than AddressRiskReport. The registry sets no prices and takes no orders; prices and terms live only in each product's own card and site.
